title: Coyote Valley Dam and Lake Mendocino Sewage and Septic Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SPD > W075 ENDIST SAN FRAN
description: Coyote Valley Dam and Lake Mendocino Sewage and Septic Services. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 12. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. An optional site visit may be requested. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), San Francisco District is seeking to contract professional septic services for Coyote Valley Dam (CVD) (Lake Mendocino) located at Lake Mendocino, Ukiah, California. The work and responsibility of the contractor shall include all job planning, programming, scheduling, administration, inspection, and management necessary to accomplish specified services. The contractor shall make sure that work is accomplished in accordance with the contract and all applicable laws, municipal codes, regulations, and/or written directives issued by the Contracting Officer.
